text:
deploybot: Hotfix rollout rbld/serving:20260703-hotpatch auto-PAUSED in us-east1 after burn-in failures on long-seq requests (increased 5xx for model-realtime). Full logs: https://internal.logs/serving/1815009999 :rotating_light:

rohit: Noted. This build touched attention cache retention. Is the failure deterministic?

eva: Reproduces on our extended integration test: long prompts + streaming enabled. Fails after ~45s with internal chunking error.

sre-lead: Quick metrics: us-east1 model-realtime 5xx +1.7% over baseline in 20m, p99 token latency +250ms. Failure concentrated on nodes with GPUs that had older driver versions.

product-ops: SLA impact? Any customers affected or only fallback paths?

eva: Mostly fallbacks and degraded streaming; a handful of API retries surfaced. Product sees some elevated error pages for long-session workloads.

sre-lead: We can either: 1) full regional rollback to rbld/serving:20260628-stable 2) require a burn-in exemption and manual expedited pin of a quick rebuild that disables streaming chunking 3) take affected nodes out of rotation and continue canary elsewhere.

cora: If we do an exemption, what's the rollback guardrail? We need explicit abort thresholds and a safety escrow (holdback) to flip if anything regresses.

rohit: I have a micro-rebuild that toggles chunking to legacy mode: rbld/serving:20260703-hotpatch.1. It should fix the error for long sessions. ETA 20m to push. I'd request an expedited pin with safety-escrow of 20% (meaning hold 20% of region capacity on stable image until final approval). Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sre-lead: I like the holdback idea. Set abort: sustained 5xx > baseline+0.6% for 10m -> auto-rollback. Also require visible burn-in of 30m at 5% before ramp. We'll keep pager on.

product-ops: Approve expedited pin for a constrained burn-in if SRE confirms alerts and holdback. I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb.

deploybot: Manual expedited pin request recorded: ```
# expedited pin with safety escrow
deploybot pin --image=rbld/serving:20260703-hotpatch.1 --scope=us-east1 --percentage=5 --safety-escrow=20 --reason="disable chunking for long-session burn-in; quick mitigation"
```

cora: +1 from ops assuming SRE alerting and rollback plan are in place.

rohit: Pushing image and starting 5% canary now. Will post progress at 10m, 30m.

sre-lead: Alerts configured. Dash: https://dashboards/internal/serving/us-east1. Pager will escalate on abort.

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 12m. No new 5xxs. Holding to 30m burn-in window.

product-ops: Draft note (internal): "Hotfix: targeted burn-in for long-session chunking fix in us-east1. We held 20% capacity as safety escrow; canary running at 5%. No action required by customers." Link to post will follow.

rohit: 30m reached, telemetry green. Proceeding to 50% ramp with safety-escrow still enforced. Will monitor next 15m then full roll.

sre-lead: Ramp started. If any threshold breaches, immediate rollback target: rbld/serving:20260628-stable.

eva: Thanks team. We'll capture timeline for the post-deploy notes and a short blameless review if needed.
